intended_object: The canonical projection A → A/\overline{A^n}, bundled as a continuous group homomorphism. Here A is a commutative topological group and A/\overline{A^n} is its quotient by the closure of the subgroup of n-th powers. Inferred from the docstring and the definition of `TopologicalPowerQuotient`.
explanation:
`TopologicalPowerQuotient A n` is the abbreviation `A ⧸ closedPowers A n`, and `closedPowers A n` is the topological closure of the range of `powMonoidHom n`, i.e. the closure of the subgroup of n-th powers. `mkQ` takes the group homomorphism `QuotientGroup.mk'` for this subgroup and proves it continuous with `QuotientGroup.continuous_mk`. This is exactly the canonical continuous quotient homomorphism.

On generality: the setting is a commutative topological group with n ∈ ℕ, which is the natural one for the n-th-power quotient. The subgroup of n-th powers only exists as the range of a homomorphism when the group is commutative.

I searched Mathlib for a continuous homomorphism (`→ₜ*`) into a quotient group and found none. Mathlib only provides the unbundled map `QuotientGroup.mk'` and the separate continuity lemma `QuotientGroup.continuous_mk`, so there is no exact Mathlib counterpart. Nothing is missing and no junk values are involved.
